salamanca.alt: Master plan — reconnecting river, railway and community
salamanca.caption: Master plan — reconnecting river, habitat and community
salamanca.description: Bridges, wetlands, restored woodland, viewing mounds and community gardens form a connected landscape across the former railway site.

salamanca.alt: Bridge and planting — responding to changing water levels
salamanca.caption: Bringing bonds to the community
salamanca.description: Community gardens reuse treated ground; a terraced ridgeline organizes movement; a permeable plaza supports gathering; and capped soil forms a viewing mound. The bridge connects these spaces across the site.

weaving.alt: Master plan — outdoor learning, access and cultural memory
weaving.caption: Master plan — weaving cultural memory into everyday use
weaving.description: Platforms, ramps, planting and a commemorative wall connect places to study, gather and hold outdoor classes.

weaving.alt: Landscape section — everyday use and outdoor learning
weaving.caption: A section through learning and gathering
weaving.description: Changes in level create places for individual study, conversation and outdoor learning. The section relates these activities to the planting and the campus edge.

weaving.caption: Entrance — access and gathering
weaving.credit: Tianzhen (Tim) Jia · Individual Cornell studio work

weaving.alt: Overlook — study, conversation and cultural memory
weaving.caption: Overlook — study, conversation and cultural memory
weaving.credit: Tianzhen (Tim) Jia · Individual Cornell studio work

wetland-utopia.alt: Reading the Pearl River Delta through water and circulation
wetland-utopia.caption: Reading the Pearl River Delta through water and circulation
Ship-route study — moving through the Pearl River delta
wetland-utopia.description: The route study compares the large river channel with its smaller tributaries. Passenger boats, cargo ships, fishing boats and pleasure craft use different parts of this network; these movements inform the proposed tour route.

carbon.alt: Land cover — a regional framework for carbon storage
carbon.caption: Land cover — a regional framework for carbon storage

carbon.alt: Maple, beech and birch — forest community in section
carbon.caption: Maple, beech and birch — forest community in section

xiaozhou.alt: Residents, visitors and heritage — overlapping needs
xiaozhou.caption: Residents, visitors and heritage — overlapping needs
xiaozhou.description: The diagram compares tourism's need for openness, daily life's need for privacy and conservation's need to protect the buildings.

xiaozhou.alt: Concept map linking environmental degradation with tourism, everyday life and cultural continuity
xiaozhou.caption: Environmental quality, local life and cultural continuity
xiaozhou.description: The research diagram connects declining environmental quality with the visitor experience, residents' quality of life and the capacity to maintain cultural heritage. It is a conceptual framework from the field study.

xiaozhou.caption: A shared framework for residents, artists and visitors
xiaozhou.description: Separate activity zones sit within shared landscape facilities, a coordinated architectural character and an overall framework for community life.

salinity.alt: Complete minirhizotron photograph showing branching fungal filaments and dense mycelium
salinity.caption: Fungal structures — visual identification in soil imagery
salinity.description: White branching filaments and dense fan-like structures are visible within the soil scan.

salinity.caption: Rhizomorph abundance — observations over time
salinity.description: Observations over the 2018 and 2019 growing seasons. The complete original figure retains the Julian-day axis, abundance axis and error bars.

parking.alt: Physical model — testing the waterfront topography
parking.caption: Physical model — testing the waterfront topography
parking.description: A layered terrain model studies the relationship between the existing industrial edge and the proposed waterfront landform.

parking.alt: Cut & fill — from industrial ground to a living shoreline
parking.caption: Cut & fill — from industrial ground to a living shoreline
parking.description: Depressions collect water while raised landforms create new habitat. The study brings wetland pockets, planting and a gradually naturalized Autoport into one continuous waterfront.

parking.alt: Master plan — a connected, adaptive waterfront
parking.caption: Master plan — a connected, adaptive waterfront
parking.description: Swamp pockets, wetland depressions, a wildlife observatory and the naturalized Autoport connect along the waterfront. The plan brings public access and ecological adaptation together.

parking.caption: Phase 1 — Planning and preparation
parking.group: A waterfront that changes in stages
parking.groupDescription: Read the four phases in order: preparation, relocation, construction, then ecological restoration. These are design scenarios for the proposal.

parking.caption: Phase 2 — Relocation of critical neighborhoods
parking.group: A waterfront that changes in stages

parking.caption: Phase 3 — Construction of resilient landscapes
parking.group: A waterfront that changes in stages

parking.caption: Phase 4 — Restored nature and ecosystems
parking.group: A waterfront that changes in stages

parking.caption: 2050 · Wetland depression
parking.groupDescription: Follow each landscape through 2050, 2070 and 2100 to see the proposed changes in water, vegetation and access. Compare the three dated views for each place. These drawings explore possible futures rather than predict outcomes.

bamboo.alt: The completed bamboo garden, with grass, a stone path and timber gathering deck
bamboo.caption: A small garden, made tangible
bamboo.description: The planted edge, curving stone path, lawn and timber gathering deck form a small landscape for everyday use.

bamboo.alt: Garden plan — planting, paths and gathering
bamboo.caption: Garden direction 01 — a planted edge and winding path
bamboo.description: The sketch connects a bamboo edge and planting with a deck, gathering spaces and a stone-and-grass path.
bamboo.groupDescription: Two complete hand sketches explore different relationships between planting, stone paths and gathering space.

bamboo.alt: Second complete hand-drawn bamboo garden concept plan
bamboo.caption: Garden direction 02 — an alternative layout
bamboo.description: A broad stone path links planting, a timber platform and several places to sit and gather.

bamboo.alt: Complete bamboo garden layout with deck, stone path, planting and dimensions
bamboo.caption: From garden sketch to construction layout
bamboo.description: The layout relates the stone path, gathering deck, pergola and bamboo edge to site dimensions. Original drawing labels remain intact.

alumni.alt: Complete planting perspective showing height, texture and seasonal layers
alumni.caption: Planting layers — height, texture and seasonal change
Planting plan — the complete Alumni Slope
alumni.description: The plan uses plant height, layering and seasonal color to screen the parking area. Letter codes identify species; the number below each code records the quantity in that planting group.

alumni.alt: Planting layout — structure, quantities and spacing
alumni.caption: Planting layout — structure, quantities and spacing
alumni.description: A second view of the same planting plan makes the arrangement of shrubs, grasses and perennials easier to read. The species codes correspond to the key above.
